notes.title: UPDATE - Version 1.2!
notes.notes:
A new update should be available for all now! (you may need to validate your installation)

- A new "destination marker" was added, for easier navigation.

- Removed 60fps cap, The game will now sync with your monitors' refresh rate (so, uncapped - but 24fps cap is still available for "a e s t h e t i c s" )

- New resolution scaling, support for 16:10 and beyond (not been able to test with ultrawide, but the fix should scale)

- Fixed the "Trying to Remember" achievement not unlocking for some players. (This will likely require a new playthrough. Apologies for the inconvenience) 

- Resolved issues caused when using Alt-Tab during certain cutscenes.

- Scene transitions have been overhauled to be faster, more slick and less distracting,
 
- Text/dialogue display timings have been tweaked across the game.

- Additional small bug fixes & some lighting improvements

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

Please let me know of any issues in the Steam forums.

Many thanks,

Syine.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi, thank you all so much for all the feedback and bug-spotting! Sorry for any inconvenience caused, and please do continue to tell me of any issues you find.

Patch 1.01: 

- Starting a "New Game" immediately after finishing the game now correctly resets the game state

- Certain Items can no longer be picked up twice

- Corrected various spelling errors

- Improved visibility for certain Pick-ups

- Various Scene improvements and interaction fixes

I am currently looking to implement Steam Achievements, but this may take some time.

Thanks again to all who have supported the game so far, I hope this little update improves your experiences.

Happy New Year!
